    # Extract territory info if available
    territory = observation.get('territory', {})

    # Helper to compute Manhattan distance
    def dist(a, b):
        return abs(a[0] - b[0]) + abs(a[1] - b[1])

    # Defense: Set default values
    resource_positions = resources
    enemy_positions = opponent_positions
    own_territory = territory

    # Decide movement based on scenario
